stemMd: Which functional group identifies an alcohol?

options.label: B
options.textMd: A hydroxyl group attached to a saturated carbon atom

options.label: D
options.textMd: A nitrogen atom bonded to three hydrogens with no carbon

options.label: E
options.textMd: A carbonyl group between two carbon groups

explanationMd: An alcohol contains an –OH group attached to a saturated carbon. Functional-group recognition focuses on the local bonding arrangement. A carboxyl group contains an OH too, but its neighbouring carbonyl makes it a different functional group.

distractorRationale.e: That is characteristic of a ketone.
distractorRationale.a: That identifies an alkyne feature, not an alcohol.
distractorRationale.d: That describes ammonia rather than an alcohol.
